external_games.name: La Vie d'Emma: Infirmière de Choc

name: La Vie d'Emma: Infirmière de Choc
storyline:
This is Emma’s first day as a nurse. In the hospital of his uncle, who supervises his training, you will have to care for patients and progress by passing tests of progressive difficulty.
From reception to appropriate care, you will have to pay attention both to what you say, to reassure the patients, and to what you do, to relieve them as soon as possible.
Cuts, bruises, choking, fractures, heart attacks, soon nothing will resist your stylet!
